methodology.candidate: Normal Cargo release with the recorded parent revision plus the exact runtime patch embedded in build.runtime_patch. Current production source SHA256 and actual binary hashes are verified; compiler remains linked. Each CLI packs identical sources with its corresponding ordinary host.
methodology.wall_ms: Native C helper starts CLOCK_MONOTONIC before posix_spawn, drains stdout, queries root-process counters and stops after wait4 reaps the root. Includes native loading, VM/artifact/engine initialization, target execution, real CLI child work where applicable, telemetry shutdown, destruction and exit. No phase subtraction or reconstruction.
methodology.cases: Empty Main, print ready, JSON/defaults/callbacks/floats/catch, 1000 extra functions, typed/default arguments, generated help, wrapper --version, wrapper run --help. Wrapper commands use the same real release baml-cli child (cli-child), with an explicit local toolchain path; no placeholder child.
methodology.telemetry: off sets BAML_TELEMETRY=off; local omits it and uses default local recording. Isolated HOME/BAML_HOME, auto_check=false, fixed real BAML_TOOLCHAIN, allow-direct CLI; no inherited credentials/cloud destination or production cloud traffic. Pack/smoke checks use telemetry off.
methodology.sampling: 100 rounds x 8 commands x 2 releases x 2 recording modes = 3200 timed fresh launches, plus 3 warmups for each of 32 variants (96 launches). Fixed seed 20261004, shuffled interleaving. 18 independent output/error correctness launches.
methodology.external_builds: All own release/test/Clippy workers complete before timing. Harness also waits before warmups and each round for all rustc/cargo/clippy workers to disappear. All 100 round-start snapshots are retained and clear. Work beginning inside a round and other desktop activity remain uncontrolled.
methodology.caches: Executable/file caches warmed; fresh processes, not a cold-cache/boot test. No physical Linux/Windows/iOS/Wasm latency conclusion.
methodology.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95 (95th sorted sample of 100), min and max; compare complete wall times directly. Desktop measurements and p95 remain noisy. Do not infer physical Linux/Windows/iOS/Wasm performance from this one ARM Mac.
methodology.other_metrics: CPU is OS user+system accounting, including reaped-child usage as attributed by wait4. Root near-exit instruction/cycle/footprint/I/O counters are not a summed process-tree total. RSS is wait4 peak RSS. Counters are supporting data; full wall time is the outcome.
methodology.raw_encoding: columns gives metric order; each raw.samples row reconstructs one complete scalar sample. Lossless reconstruction and all 32 summaries verified against original output.
methodology.replay: Restore compare.py and the C helper/BAML wrapper sources from sources; adjust the two recorded absolute source paths to the replay checkout. Prepare the two ordinary release CLI/host directories at the recorded revisions and copy the baseline real CLI to OUTPUT/cli-child. Run the recorded measurement command with those output paths. from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MAGIC=b"BAMLART\0"
def u32(data,offset): return struct.unpack_from("<I",data,offset)[0]
def u64(data,offset): return struct.unpack_from("<Q",data,offset)[0]
def section(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();assert u32(data,0)==0xfeedfacf
 offset=32
 for _ in range(u32(data,16)):
  command,length=struct.unpack_from("<II",data,offset)
  if command==0x19:
   for i in range(u32(data,offset+64)):
    start=offset+72+80*i
    if data[start:start+16].rstrip(b"\0")==b"baaaaaaaaaaaaaml":
     size=u64(data,start+40);file_offset=u32(data,start+48)
     return data[file_offset:file_offset+size]
  offset+=length
 raise AssertionError(path)
def artifact(data):
 assert data.startswith(MAGIC)
 fmt=u32(data,8);headerlen=u64(data,12);fp_len=u32(data,20)
 fp=data[24:24+fp_len];kind=data[24+fp_len]
 payloadlen=u64(data,25+fp_len);digest=data[33+fp_len:65+fp_len]
 assert headerlen==45+fp_len
 payload=data[20+headerlen:20+headerlen+payloadlen]
 assert len(payload)==payloadlen
 metadata=struct.pack("<II",fmt,fp_len)+fp+bytes([kind])+struct.pack("<Q",payloadlen)
 assert hashlib.sha256(metadata+payload).digest()==digest
 return fmt,fp,payload,20+headerlen+payloadlen
# Normalize only authenticated artifact identity/hash fields; all payload bytes
# and positions, including nested artifacts, otherwise must match exactly.
def normalize(data):
 output=bytearray(data);offset=0;identities=[]
 while (index:=data.find(MAGIC,offset))!=-1:
  fmt,fp,payload,length=artifact(data[index:])
  fp_len=len(fp);output[index+24:index+24+fp_len]=b"0"*fp_len
  output[index+33+fp_len:index+65+fp_len]=b"0"*32
  identities.append({'offset':index,'format':fmt,'fingerprint':fp.decode(),'payload_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()})
  offset=index+20+45+fp_len
 return bytes(output),identities
artifacts={};matches={}
for name in ('baml','empty','hello','features','large','typed','error'):
 values={}
 for revision in ('baseline','candidate'):
  path=ROOT/revision/(name+'-packed');data=section(path)
  fmt,fp,payload,length=artifact(data)
  assert fmt==12
  normalized,identities=normalize(data[:length])
  values[revision]=normalized
  artifacts[revision+'/'+name+'-packed']={'format':fmt,'binary_bytes':path.stat().st_size,'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'artifact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data[:length]).hexdigest(),'payload_bytes':len(payload),'payload_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'build_fingerprint':fp.decode(),'nested_artifacts':identities}
 assert values['baseline']==values['candidate'],name
 matches[name]=hashlib.sha256(values['baseline']).hexdigest()
(ROOT/'fixtures.json').write_text(json.dumps({'artifacts':artifacts,'normalized_matches':matches},indent=2)+'\n')
print('All seven normal format-12 packed payloads match after authenticated build identity/hash normalization.')
